name: Sheet
summary: A panel from the start, end or bottom edge, for a side task or the details of one item while its list stays in view: a title, the body and the answers. Not for a question that needs an answer first (use a Dialog), for a short choice by its button (use a Popover) or for a pane the layout keeps on screen (use Pane).
a11y: Modal: the native `dialog` opened with `showModal()` (the page behind is inert, Tab cycles inside) and the Dialog's focus rules: focus starts on the first control in the body (the title when there's none) and returns to whatever opened it. Standard (`modal={false}`): a complementary region named by its title; focus moves to its title on open and back to the opener on close, and the page stays usable. Both are named by the title, described by the description; the close button is named "Close". The body is a scroll region with its padding inside, so its scrollbar sits at the sheet's edge and focus rings are never clipped. While loading, the body is busy and the rest stays usable. Slides in from its edge; with reduced motion it appears at once.

keys.action: move through the sheet's controls only (modal)

props.name: open
props.description: Shown while true. The parent owns it: set it false in `onClose`.

props.name: onClose
props.description: Escape, the close button or (modal) a press on the scrim asked to close.

props.name: title
props.description: What the sheet holds, e.g. "Filters" or the item's name: its accessible name.

props.name: description
props.description: One short sentence under the title. Its accessible description.

props.name: children
props.description: The body: details, a form, a list. Scrolls inside the sheet; the header and the actions stay put.

props.name: actions
props.description: The answers at the foot, as Buttons: the safest first, the main action last.

props.name: headerActions
props.description: Up to two quiet icon-only Buttons beside Close, for things about the whole sheet (open in a new page, more).

props.name: side
props.description: The edge it comes from. `end` (default) and `start` follow the reading direction; `bottom` is for small windows.

props.name: size
props.description: Width of a side sheet: `s` 20 rem, `m` 26 rem (default), `l` 40 rem. Every size fills a narrow window. Ignored for `bottom`.

props.name: modal
props.description: Modal (default): over a scrim, the page waits, focus stays inside. `false`: a standard sheet that sits over the edge of the page while the page stays usable (a complementary region, not a dialog).

props.name: loading
props.description: The body's content is on its way: lines of skeleton in its place; the title, close and actions stay usable.
